authority: Independent read-only QUALITY re-review of exactly four named QA files and original five R2 fixes. SPEC R3 was read first. No product changes, old tests/gates/reports, network, runtime secret reads, installation, commit or push authorized.
timing_note: Elapsed uses first independently measured reviewer monotonic clock. Final return time is reported separately from this immutable scope snapshot; no inferred or clamped finish timestamp.

resolved_findings.basis: Boolean endpoint/key comparisons and fixed safe codes avoid actual/expected value serialization. Callback, timer and CLI exceptions are contained. Sentinel tests and additional failure probe emitted no private exception text.

Shared settled gate prevents double callbacks. Error/abort/close/timeout paths destroy independent agent:false transport. Live request/socket counts are retained until close events. Additional timeout/request-close/socket-error/response-close/oversize probes each completed once and closed tracked resources.

Initialization and exercise failures retain safe primary codes, destroy failures are separate, and emergency cleanup and failure evidence survive nested exceptions. Additional throwing exercise/destroy/status/report-write probe passed with primary failure preserved.

Post-destroy module counters, console identities and timer/request/socket counts are captured before force-cleanup. Leaks prevent passed=true even when emergency cleanup later removes them. Independent tests cover timer/pending/busy/console/request/socket residue and clean control.
Nonempty placeholder public-build is explicitly configured; public is only independently identified genuinely disabled compiled input. Targeted documentation test passed.

role_boundary.https_scope: Actual APP main-entry network smoke: app._elctonLog -> original bundled L -> Node HTTPS; nine explicitly injected stage rows, not WE factory fifteen-stage coverage.
role_boundary.separate_host_factory_scope: Actual compiled factory fifteen-stage HOST testing is separate parent execution, must be labelled HOST mock ACK; the scoped host script's lifecycle/bridge/reference checks alone do not establish that fifteen-stage result.

independent_targeted_tests.evidence_source: Actual reviewer terminal TAP output; no old evidence overwritten.

suggestions: Keep transport close-event probes as future QA-only regression coverage; no changes made in this read-only task.
Keep exact input APP/JS hashes and independently obtained CI/cloud readbacks separate from HOST/mock and adapter test receipts.
issues_encountered: An assumed compiled-logger-quality-r2.json did not exist. The supplied original failed report was compiled-logger-spec-r2.json; read and hash-checked that exact original without broader searching.
First reviewer hash command failed with Python command-line newline quoting (exit 1), before hashes or writes. Corrected read-only command succeeded; this was reviewer tooling, not a QA failure.
summary: PASS on scoped QUALITY: all five original defects resolved; independent QA tests 15/15 and five additional in-memory transport cases plus nested-failure probe green. Exact four byte hashes match SPEC R3 and remain unchanged. No actual APP/network/factory fifteen-stage/device ACK/new-CI/readback success claimed. Only this new report written.
